summary: With multiple sources, variables merge in the order you pass -i, so the last wins; in a directory, sources merge alphabetically by filename, so use numeric prefixes to control order.
questions: Which inventory wins if I pass -i staging -i production?
How do I control load order of inventory files in a directory?
Why is my variable taking the value from the wrong inventory file?

answer_card.title: Control inventory variable load order
answer_card.answer_md:
- Command line: merge order = order of `-i`. With `myvar=1` in staging and `2` in production, `-i staging -i production` gives `2`; reversed gives `1`.
- Directory: alphabetical by filename. Prefix files to control it:
```text
inventory/
  01-openstack.yml
  02-dynamic-inventory.py
  03-static-inventory      # its myvar wins
  group_vars/all.yml
```
